title: PagoKit Payment Methods (schema v2)
description: Schema for skills/payment-advisor/data/methods.json. A method is a rail a buyer can pay with - not a provider.

reversibility.description: chargeback = card-style dispute rights; refund_only = merchant can refund but buyer cannot dispute; irreversible_no_refund = A2A rails where 'refund the charge' does not exist; mandate_indemnity = Bacs/PAD-style claw-back weeks after success.

expiry_seconds.description: BLIK 120s, MB WAY ~240s, OXXO/boleto days. Without it the state machine has no timeout state.

pending_status_lies.description: Provider reports a success-shaped status while the money has NOT arrived (e.g. KOMOJU konbini returns authorized meaning UNPAID). Fulfilling on it ships free goods.

network_of.description: This method is reached through a network contract, e.g. alipay_plus.

deny_list.description: The generator must refuse to emit this rail.
